items.question: Can five-product differences be attributed to Harness independently of model and Skill?
items.known: Visible/requested model and built-in Skill conditions differ. S02 matches only recorded conditions within Codex.
items.impact: No pure five-product Harness ranking or numerical causal effect
items.next_action: For the next causal experiment, first require attestable model/Skill and common tool contracts; otherwise restrict the question to observable conditional behavior.
items.stop_condition: If these controls cannot be exposed by the product interface, stop pursuing independent attribution in this batch; reopen only when new official configuration/provenance becomes available.

items.question: What were the full artifact bytes exactly at the old 1200-second cutoff?
items.known: All 25 strict cutoff scores are null; early original chains in a subset do not prove a full cutoff snapshot.
items.impact: No old uniform-budget score or speed ranking
items.next_action: Only accept a snapshot actually captured at the old deadline with timestamps and matching file hashes. A newly created file or mtime is not retrospective evidence. Future experiments need a new snapshot protocol.
items.stop_condition: The current public source audit contains no complete deadline snapshots; stop further inference from completion labels or eventual artifacts. Reopen only upon discovery of contemporaneous snapshots, leaving scores unknown meanwhile.

items.question: Do GUI products meet internal E1 read/write/error contracts?
items.known: Native artifacts and reviewed UI support E2, while complete internal request parameters are absent for many observations.
items.impact: Do not treat unknown E1 as zero, full marks or a ranking of internal capability
items.next_action: Check a supported ordinary event export if available; otherwise keep the public UI/file judgment at E2.
items.stop_condition: If a supported export cannot expose paired ordinary requests/results by the next review, stop repeating the same UI capture for this question. Reopen only with a new supported evidence source.

items.question: Have independent reviewers reproduced the two key conclusions?
items.known: A two-claim review packet has been prepared on 2026-10-21, but no external reproduction feedback has been received. Current collection and review remain single-operator with AI assistance; CI and agent review are not external independent review.
items.next_action: The user can share the prepared two-claim packet; accept dated feedback only if a reviewer actually performs the reproduction. Keep the item incomplete without that feedback.
items.stop_condition: If no external review is received by 2026-10-24, deliver the self-contained packet and retain this limitation; do not count an invitation or prepared document as completed review.

items.question: Is the grader correct for all near-correct CSV/JSON answers?
items.known: Three bounded gap types are covered by selected counterexamples and positive controls; this is not a proof over all answer encodings or all tasks.
items.impact: Do not turn 22 passing synthetic expectations into a universal grader correctness rate
items.next_action: Accept new counterexamples tied to a concrete completion condition; add a positive control and named rule version before extending the grader.
items.stop_condition: Stop this repair batch when all fixed expectations and rule ablations pass and the historical-impact audit is complete. Reopen for a concrete new counterexample, not merely to increase the example count.
